delete.description:
Owner deletes a selfie before the 45-day purge; the record and its hours stay. Audited.
No screen yet (product owner, 2026-11-20). Staff cannot delete selfies, not even their own.

get.description: O14 "Selfie masuk / pulang". PoC: the photo bytes (no Storage bucket yet), never cached.

O11 rows: reversals, status changes, and payment changes of orders, newest first, 50 per
page. Default range: month to date in each outlet's own zone; `date_from`/`date_to` in the
response are the outlet's (WIB for all outlets) and only label the range picker.

O2 tab Ringkasan: KPI tiles, peta keramaian, keramaian outlet sekarang, order per jam,
stok rendah & sold out, komposisi per kanal, and metode bayar. The busyness map, current
crowd, and low stock ignore `period` and `hours`. `period=range` ("Rentang") needs `from`
and `to` (at most 92 days, `to` not after today).

O2b drawer: the paid orders behind the Revenue / Order tile, an Order per jam bar
(`hour`), or an Item terlaris row (`product_id`). `summary`, `by_outlet`, and `item` ignore
the chip (`method`), Kanal (`channel`), and search (`q`); the list applies every filter.

O17: Ringkasan PO for `month` (default: this month in the outlet's zone, WIB for all
outlets; by PO open date). Pembayaran supplier and PO ada selisih ignore the month and
list every PO that needs action (FR3.11). One transaction, so every card reads the same
Postgres `now()` — the default month included — and they agree around midnight.
O2 "Item terlaris": top 5 by quantity sold for today, this month, or this year.

post.description: O9 "Simpan pengeluaran". Append-only; a mistake is corrected with a reversal.

get.description: O9b KPI cards and supplier bars. `po_owed` is as of today (not the range).

post.description: O9 "Salah input? Buat entry reversal, bukan edit." (expenses only).

events — `delta` ({text}) while the reply is written, then one `final` ({reply_text,

the button-flow endpoints.
